method: Twenty identity overview sheets checked against exact derived member hashes; one held-out sheet inspected at full resolution; prior full-resolution review of the approved target styles retained. Only for a bounded learning experiment.
limit: Fourteen nail components were excluded to keep the target a literal isolated crop of the approved styled image. Enlarging 512x512 source nails exposes blocky mask edges and soft detail; this is not production-quality approval.
